instruction: An action sports full shot captures a dynamic scene inside a martial arts studio featuring a brick wall on the left and a large window on the right. On the left, the young girl with braided hair (R4) wearing a white gi and a red belt performs a high side kick directed towards the right. On the right, the bearded instructor with a headband (R6) wearing a black gi mirrors her movement, performing a high side kick directed towards the left. The two are positioned facing each other in mid-kick, demonstrating synchronized technique. Natural light streams in from the large window, brightly illuminating the wooden floor.
elements: R4 is the young girl/student performing a high side kick whose movement is mirrored by R6
R6 is the bearded instructor mirroring R4's high side kick
R4 and R6 face each other while executing high side kicks toward one another
R4 wears a martial arts gi with a red belt during the kick
the action takes place inside a martial arts studio with a large window
